findings.current: शुल्क की पुष्टि जाँची जा रही है।
findings.evidence: Pleonastic double passive: the object of «जाँची जा रही है» is «पुष्टि», so the line says the confirmation is being examined rather than the charge being confirmed. The shipped construction this borrows from takes a report as its object (ui.chat.pickers.usage_view.checking_for_an_updated_usage_report), so the pattern does not carry over to पुष्टि. The key's contract is a three-word neutral status sentence; this runs to eight words.
findings.suggested: «शुल्क की पुष्टि की जा रही है।» (confirmation of the charge is underway; keeps पुष्टि and the charge noun).

findings.evidence: A bare noun compound names the constraint where the other five labels name the state or failure (अस्वीकृत, गेट विफल, अज्ञात टूल, अमान्य आर्ग्युमेंट, डुप्लिकेट id). It is grammatical as a label and the sentence below carries the meaning, but the shipped hi corpus only hyphenates this noun (दर-सीमा / दर-सीमाएँ) or uses it inside a clause (दर सीमा लगी है).
findings.suggested: «ऑडियो दर-सीमा» (hyphenated noun, matching the shipped form) if the noun label is kept; a participle form would read as a state but has no shipped precedent to anchor it.
